selection_basis: Qualified Kotlin backend alternatives across the exposed backend regression; not independent held-out data or full-catalog enrichment

facts.capability: Kotlin application support. Kotlin coroutines are supported in Spring MVC and WebFlux controllers and WebFlux functional server APIs.
facts.scope: Spring Framework MVC/WebFlux; coroutine dependencies are required
facts.limitations: Does not establish compatibility with a particular project version, deployment or integration readiness

facts.capability: Kotlin application support through Spring Framework and related Spring projects, with project generation and Kotlin dependency management.
facts.scope: Spring Boot and its Spring project dependencies; Kotlin libraries/compiler configuration required
facts.limitations: Does not imply every Spring module is installed or every project version is compatible

facts.capability: Kotlin REST service development using the Quarkus Kotlin and REST extensions.
facts.scope: quarkus-kotlin plus Quarkus REST extensions, with Kotlin compiler configuration
facts.limitations: Extension support is not proof of compatibility with a user's selected extension versions

facts.capability: Kotlin JVM application support, HTTP server applications and HTTP routing.
facts.scope: Micronaut framework; selected HTTP server/runtime components must be configured
facts.limitations: No claim of measured startup, memory, coroutine coverage or project-specific integration readiness

facts.capability: Kotlin coroutine-based asynchronous client and server application development.
facts.scope: Ktor client/server libraries; selected server engine and plugins must be configured
facts.limitations: Does not establish complete application features or compatibility of selected plugins
